name: test_requirement_upload_rejects_unapproved_or_disguised_extensions[virus.exe]
description:
Objective: Requirement upload rejects unapproved or disguised extensions — data partition: filename='virus.exe'.
Preconditions: Repository dependencies are installed; execute in the deterministic lane with no deployed-service or customer-data dependency.
Steps:
1. Run the case in the repository deterministic lane with the deployed browser/service fixtures disabled.
2. Import the production-support rule or page-object contract exercised by tests/unit/requirements/test_requirements_rules.py.
3. Apply the exact parameter partition recorded in Test Data: {"filename": "virus.exe"}
4. Invoke `validate_requirement_extension` with the recorded partition and capture its return value or raised error.
5. Evaluate the deterministic assertion(s): `pytest.raises(ValueError, match='PDF, PNG, or JPEG')`.
6. Record any mismatch as a normal failure; do not skip, xfail, silently retry, or weaken the assertion.
Expected: 1. Observable scenario outcome: Requirement upload rejects unapproved or disguised extensions.
2. The outcome applies specifically to the recorded partition: {"filename": "virus.exe"}
3. The authoritative deterministic expression(s) evaluate as encoded: `pytest.raises(ValueError, match='PDF, PNG, or JPEG')`.
4. No unintended record, state transition, notification, or cross-test data residue is produced.
